scenes.setting: Deweyville Library: Klein links Sirius Arapis to Welch and Hanass Vincent from the borrowing records, then turns to leave
Deweyville Library: Sirius himself walks in to return the journals; a librarian panics and Klein shoots him through the oriel window
scenes.text_anchor: At this moment, he saw a man enter the library with his head hung low.

scenes.setting: Green field and alley behind the library: the wounded, wart-covered Sirius pounces; Klein empties his revolver and beats him down with the cane
scenes.text_anchor: This was the area lining the back of Deweyville Library's ground floor.
